DESIGN DECISIONS A VERIFIER SHOULD KNOW: (a) IDENTITY PROJECTION — the page path is comparisons/<identity-slug>.md (the literal reading of §2.2's identity rule). When the subject is a known entity, the comparison page SHARES a basename with the entity page; the link checker's first-wins slug map (alphabetical walk: comparisons/ before entities/) resolves bare-slug links to the comparison page, so in thin wikis the subject's ENTITY page can be flagged orphaned (report-only warning, observed in the stage tests' validation output; links still resolve and both pages are on-topic). The subject self-link is rendered plain inside comparison pages (the composite fellow-member precedent). Path-scoped linking is a possible future refinement, out of scope. (b) ONE comparison prompt — the permissive leg of the strict → permissive → shell chain reuses comparison.prompt.txt (the phase doc's file list sanctions one file; its Layer-2 contract is already the row-value preservation contract). (c) tables OPTIONAL at the schema level (absent stays valid) — pre-Phase-23 extraction JSON and every pre-existing test fixture stay valid untouched; the prompt still instructs always emitting it and the agent always fills []. (d) Citations: table sections cite the table's OWN page (file|<page>) — more precise than the chunk range — while bridge claims cite the claim's chunk range (the entity-page convention); frontmatter sources aggregate both. (e) The bridge reads ONLY live curated topics (a dropped topic's claims can never produce a broken topic link). (f) The comparison frontmatter title uses the escapeYamlString house style (YAML-sensitive titles JSON-quote — the phase-22 precedent; the DOX catalog test derives its expectation from disk). (g) Section-scoped row-value checking: the check locates the written page's `## Table:` heading naming the source basename + exact page (p. 16 never matches p. 160) and falls back to whole-page scope when the heading was renamed — a value repeated in another section can never mask a drop (the 82,2-vs-82,9 fixture proves it).
